# Code of conduct

This project is a small open source effort. Everyone who takes part, in issues, pull
requests, discussions or reviews, follows these rules.

## Expected

- Be respectful. Disagree with the idea, not the person.
- Assume good intent. Ask before you judge.
- Keep feedback concrete: name the file, the line, the behavior.
- Accept that a maintainer can decline a change. A "no" is not an insult.

## Not accepted

- Insults, harassment, discrimination or personal attacks of any kind.
- Publishing private information of others.
- Spam, advertising or off-topic derailing.

## Enforcement

Report violations to hello@codeboarder.de. Reports are handled confidentially. The
maintainer may edit or remove content, and may block people who repeatedly break these
rules.
